node: Employer-funded workforce training and education-benefit programs
summary: Expanded the universe around the employer-funded workforce-training procurement node, emphasizing underfollowed or second-order mappings rather than obvious education headlines. The strongest supported candidates from the provided evidence are Grand Canyon Education as a higher-ed service provider with thousands of employer/education agreements, Stride as a public lifelong-learning and talent-development provider, Nelnet as an adjacent education-technology/payments and servicing platform with enterprise software/subscription cost structure, and Wabash as a customer-anchor signal showing that workforce education can appear inside supplier-recognition and procurement systems rather than education-sector coverage.
